name: Mountaineering and Climbing Courses in Pakistan

itinerary.txt: Arrival in Islamabad Activities: Arrival at Islamabad International Airport, meet and greet by the guide, and transfer to the hotel. Briefing about the training course and introduction to the instructors. Accommodation: Hotel in Islamabad.

Islamabad to Gilgit Activities: Early morning flight from Islamabad to Gilgit. Transfer to the hotel and rest. Afternoon session on basic mountaineering skills and equipment. Accommodation: Hotel in Gilgit.
Gilgit to Hopper Valley Activities: Drive from Gilgit to Hopper Valley. Set up base camp and introduction to glacier travel techniques. Accommodation: Camping in Hopper Valley.
Basic Climbing Techniques Activities: Full day training on basic climbing techniques including rope handling, knot tying, and belaying. Accommodation: Camping in Hopper Valley.
Ice Climbing Training Activities: Training on ice climbing techniques including the use of ice axes and crampons. Practice on nearby glaciers. Accommodation: Camping in Hopper Valley.
Crevasse Rescue Training Activities: Comprehensive training on crevasse rescue techniques including setting up pulley systems and self-rescue. Accommodation: Camping in Hopper Valley.
Glacier Travel Techniques Activities: Training on safe glacier travel techniques, recognizing hazards, and navigating crevasses. Accommodation: Camping in Hopper Valley.

High Altitude Climbing Preparation Activities: Preparation for high altitude climbing including acclimatization hikes and training on high-altitude sickness management. Accommodation: Camping in Hopper Valley.
Climb to Miar Peak Base Camp Activities: Trek to Miar Peak Base Camp. Set up camp and prepare for summit attempt. Accommodation: Camping at Miar Peak Base Camp.
Summit Attempt on Miar Peak Activities: Early morning start for summit attempt on Miar Peak. Practice all learned techniques during the ascent. Accommodation: Camping at Miar Peak Base Camp.
Return to Hopper Valley Activities: Descend from Miar Peak Base Camp to Hopper Valley. Debriefing session and discussion of the summit attempt. Accommodation: Camping in Hopper Valley.

Hopper Valley to Gilgit and Departure Activities: Drive from Hopper Valley to Gilgit. Flight back to Islamabad and transfer to the hotel. Closing ceremony and distribution of certificates. Accommodation: Hotel in Islamabad. What’s Included
